results.title: A Gradle build reads offline a library the resolver fetched, through the readiness view's file repository
results.summary: failed: 1 failed step(s) in 49.2s, peak 1.9 GiB (estimated 15m00s, 9.0 GiB); 1 output file(s) changed

estimate.notes: Each offline run builds Spring Boot's buildSrc and compiles the modules the core module needs: a few minutes, as in S48's gate, where a hundred compile tasks took about two. Two rounds of the resolution (the first stops at the missing library) and the consumer's own compile, one at a time: about 10 minutes. S48's gate peaked at 5.5 GiB.
